name: fix-button
title: Fix button
description: The fix for a failure: the website's dark button that signs in, counts the changes as they come back and ends on a check, all in one cell.
use_for: Reconnecting a source that stopped syncing, in its row or in Home's banner.
never: Actions that are not a fix
Moving the row while it works: every state stays in its cell
body: `state` is `broken`, `signing`, `catching` or `done`; the app moves it along after `press`. `count` is the changes so far (it counts up with Count, and the last count stays). `app` names the source in the label and for screen readers. `tone="red"` is the red version, its squares running black. The black wipes off in 420ms (`--ds-duration-wipe`), longer than the console's usual 320ms ceiling because it reports a rare, slow action.
